verdict.rationale: Bugbot runs autonomously in the background once enabled: it reviews every new PR and PR update with no manual trigger. Admins can shape that behavior through repository selection, BUGBOT.md rules, effort levels and organization-wide rules in Bugbot Automations, and community users confirm it runs live in their orgs. However, the only automation is the fixed PR-review workflow; users cannot define their own triggers, tasks or schedules. Missing for 10: user-defined automations beyond PR review, custom or scheduled triggers, documentation of Bugbot Automations as more than a rules surface.
